snippet.title: Pulitzer Prize Stories: Journalism That Changed History (Full Documentary)
snippet.description:
The Pulitzer Prizes - A Legacy of Excellence, directed by Oscar and Emmy winner Kirk Simon, marks the 100-year anniversary of one of the world’s most prestigious honors in journalism and the arts. Through powerful, real-life stories, the film brings to life the courage, truth, and impact behind Pulitzer-winning work.

Featuring dramatic readings by acclaimed actors including Helen Mirren, Natalie Portman, Liev Schreiber, John Lithgow, and Yara Shahidi, the documentary immerses viewers in the words that shaped history - stories of war, injustice, resilience, and human triumph.

More than a celebration, this is a compelling exploration of storytelling at its highest level - revealing the voices that challenge power, bear witness to truth, and define generations.

-------

snippet.title: Love in the Time of Fentanyl | Full Documentary about Vancouver's Fentanyl Crisis
snippet.description:
As overdose deaths in Vancouver, Canada reach an all-time high, the Overdose Prevention Society opens its doors in the Downtown Eastside, a neighborhood often referred to as “ground zero of the overdose crisis.” A renegade supervised drug consumption site that employs active and former drug users, the crew do whatever it takes to save lives and give hope to a deeply marginalized population while demanding more radical responses to the devastation ravaging their community. LOVE IN THE TIME OF FENTANYL reaches beyond the stigma of drug use, revealing the courage and compassion of those on the frontlines of the crisis.

-------

Chapters
▷ 00:00 – Introduction
▷ 01:27 – The Overdose Prevention Society - Group meeting and volunteer training
▷ 10:39 – Why people turn to drugs, dependency, and quitting
▷ 19:55 – The memorial wall for those who have lost their lives from overdose
▷ 21:14 – The staff and their daily tasks at the centre
▷ 32:03 – Ron overdoses in the street and is taken to hospital
▷ 35:22 – The staff visit Dana, who is getting treatment
▷ 41:02 – Asking the mayor for a legal, safer drug supply and a 24 hour location for the OPS
▷ 43:07 – Ronnie shares his experience working with OPS and burnout
▷ 51:43 – Trey Helten takes Ron his chair at the hospital and talks about his own experience with addiction
▷ 56:06 – Turning to drugs after traumatic experience serving in the army
▷ 1:01:33 – A public demonstration followed by karaoke
▷ 1:07:29 – Ronnie decides to leave the OPS
▷ 1:16:55 – A song dedicated to those who have lost loved ones to alcohol or drug related deaths

snippet.title: Why Was My Battery Draining So Fast? | Renogy Pro Series Inverter Review
snippet.description:
I was losing over 500 watt-hours per day in my off-grid solar system without realizing it.

👉 Renogy 12V 2000W Pro Series Pure Sine Wave Inverter, with Bluetooth, EcoSleep Mode and UPS
https://dataaccess.renogy.cn/t/QY
Use code "CleverJoe" for an extra 10% off

💡 What causes battery drain in an off-grid system?
One common cause is inverter idle power consumption.

💡 What is inverter idle draw?
It is the power an inverter uses when it is turned on but not running any loads.

💡 How much power does a 2000W pure sine wave inverter use at idle?
A typical 12V 2000W pure sine wave inverter can use up to ~15–24 watts continuously.

💡 What is EcoSleep mode on the Renogy Pro Series inverter?
EcoSleep mode reduces idle power consumption to under ~10 watts when no load is detected.

💡 Why does this matter for off-grid solar systems?
Small continuous loads add up over time and can waste hundreds of watt-hours per day from a battery bank.

In this video, I compare a standard pure sine wave inverter vs the Renogy Pro Series and show how idle consumption affects real off-grid performance. Is this the perfect off-grid battery drain fix?

Reduce chemical inputs without losing productivity

Transition from conventional to regenerative systems

Renogy ShadowFlux solar panels used in this video:

This is the question I get more than any other. More than “how do you build a cabin.” More than “what tools do you need.” More than anything.
How much money do I need to start a self reliant homestead?
And I understand why. Because for most people sitting in a city apartment, paying rent, paying car payments, paying for a life that doesn’t feel like theirs — the money question is the wall. It’s the thing standing between the dream and the first real step.
So today I’m going to answer it honestly.

snippet.title: Trading golf clubs for traditional skills #bushcraft #golf #homesteading
snippet.description:
The cost of a round of golf is just ridiculous now…”
I used to golf a fair bit when I was younger, but these days? Between green fees, club memberships, expensive gear, and losing balls every round… it adds up fast.
Archery? Way more accessible. A club membership for a few hundred bucks gets you indoor/outdoor ranges, 3D courses through the woods, and a full day of walking, shooting, and hunting arrows in the terrain. Keeps the body moving and the mind sharp — plus it’s a skill you can actually use.
This is my kind of “golf” these days.
What’s your go-to outdoor activity that’s affordable and rewarding? Drop it below 👇

snippet.title: Inside the Minds of Chess Champions - The Psychology of Winning | King’s Gambit (Full Documentary)
snippet.description:
Inside the high-stakes world of elite chess, King’s Gambit uncovers the hidden psychology behind winning at the highest level. Filmed during the strongest open chess tournament ever, this gripping documentary follows world-class grandmasters as they battle pressure, obsession, and the razor-thin line between victory and defeat. With unprecedented access to top players and performance psychologists, and set against the electrifying backdrop of the Isle of Man TT, the film draws powerful parallels between mental endurance in chess and physical extremes in sport. A tense, emotional, and deeply human look at what it truly takes to win.

snippet.title: Constructing a Traditional Cob Oven for the Homestead
snippet.description:
Built this earthen oven from scratch — solo.
From mixing cob and clay with straw, framing it up with logs, to firing it up and watching those flames dance inside… every single step was mine. No helpers, just hands, mistakes, and persistence.
If I can build something like this, you can too. Real self-reliance isn’t about being perfect — it’s about starting and learning as you go.
Now it’s baking bread, pizzas, and keeping us warm the old-fashioned way.
Full build series on YouTube — link in bio! Start from the beginning and follow along.
Who else wants to build an earthen oven? Drop a 🔥 if you’re inspired.
